notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
The time has finally come! 

EVIL BELOW™ will be available on Steam (PC and Linux) and PlayStation 4 on February 17th.

We also released a new trailer to complement this announcement. You can watch it below!

[previewyoutube=1WdfAUg1aWQ;full][/previewyoutube]

This has been quite a journey and we hope everybody has a good time playing our game!
